verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a broad public API surface. It covers checkout creation, full and partial refunds, Cloud API reader pairing and naming, and an SDK that wraps the API. Its managed MCP server can "manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments," so core payment operations are clearly programmable. Nothing claims or shows parity with everything the UI does, and some surfaces are explicitly narrow, such as webhooks that only report checkout status changes. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of dashboard and POS features like customer rewards, marketing and promotions, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
